description: Mint a capability token for one tool invocation. HMAC-SHA256 signed, scope-limited to (agent_id, persona, tool_sku, args_hash, tenant_scope, expires_at), single-use. FR-ART-1..3.
skipReason: FR-ART-1..3 capability-token mint requires real agent_id (FK to agents.agent_definition), acting_persona_id (FK to persona table), and run_id (FK to agents.agent_run). Random UUIDs from {{dynamic:uuid}} violate the foreign-key constraints, so mint fails with 500. Re-enable when the test harness seeds an agent definition + persona + run via setupScript, then captures their IDs for the mint payload.
